name: Avalokitesvara Festival, Marble Mountains
nameVi: Lễ hội Quan Thế Âm Ngũ Hành Sơn
summary: A Buddhist festival at Quan The Am pagoda and across the Marble Mountains, held over three days in the second lunar month, in an annual form that dates to 1991. The hill’s usual tickets still apply unless a notice says otherwise.
when: The 17th to the 19th day of the second lunar month. Civil date: check on arrival.
